updates.blurb: Full cast of Sonic 4 announced, with Jim Carrey and Keanu Reeves returning and Nick Offerman, Matt Berry, and Richard Ayoade joining. Offerman, as well as Ben Kingsley, have voice roles.
Entertainment journalist Jeff Sneider reports Ben Kingsley as cast member of Sonic 4.
